title: Explain React Suspense
hint: Focus on how Suspense lets components declaratively wait for async operations (data fetching, code splitting) using promises and fallback boundaries.
keyPoints: Declarative fallback UI during async ops
Suspense for Data Fetching & Server Components
Difference between error boundaries and suspense boundaries

title: Explain CSS Grid vs Flexbox
hint: Compare 2D layout (rows + columns in CSS Grid) vs 1D layout (rows or columns in Flexbox) and content-first vs layout-first approaches.
keyPoints: When to combine Grid and Flexbox

title: How does the Event Loop work?
hint: Detail the Call Stack, Web APIs background processing, Microtask Queue (Promises, process.nextTick), and Macrotask Queue (setTimeout, I/O).
keyPoints: Microtask queue priority over Macrotask queue

title: How does the Virtual DOM work?
hint: Explain reconciliation, diffing heuristics (O(n) via keys and component types), and why batching matters.

title: Explain CORS and Preflight Requests
hint: Walk through simple vs preflight (OPTIONS) requests, the headers involved, and how servers enforce CORS.
keyPoints: Preflight OPTIONS and the safe-methods rule
Why custom headers and Content-Type: application/json trigger preflight

title: What are the Rules of Hooks?
hint: Explain why hooks must be called at the top level and only inside React functions, and how the dispatcher tracks state.
keyPoints: Only call hooks at the top level of components
Only call hooks from React functions
Why conditional hooks break the dispatcher

title: How do you make a website accessible?
hint: Cover semantic HTML, ARIA, keyboard navigation, color contrast, and screen reader testing.
keyPoints: Contrast ratios and screen reader testing

title: How do modern JS bundlers work?
hint: Discuss module graphs, tree shaking, code splitting, and hot module replacement in tools like Vite, Webpack, esbuild.
keyPoints: Tree shaking and dead code elimination
